empty: No model monitors yet. Click + to create one.

form.name: Name
form.namePlaceholder: Give it a name, usually the model name
form.nameHint: A label to identify this task, usually the model name.
form.targetsHint: Each channel + model pair is one target; the same model under different channels counts separately.
form.targetsEmpty: Pick channels and models to see the resulting targets.
form.targetsExpanded: The task had {before} targets; the current selection makes {after}.
form.channelHint: Multi-select. A model offered by several channels becomes one target per channel.
form.modelHint: Multi-select. Search first, then hit Select all to grab every model of one provider at once.
form.modelEmpty: No matching model under the selected channels. Add one on the channels page first.
form.intervalHint: Each round probes only one credential; multiple targets and credentials rotate in order. The actual interval carries ±30s jitter to avoid hitting upstream all at once.
form.windowHint: Pick no weekday to probe all day; with weekdays selected, probing happens only inside the window and is skipped outside it.
form.windowSameDay: The end hour is exclusive; equal start and end means all day.
form.windowCrossMidnight: A start later than the end crosses midnight, e.g. 22:00 to 05:00 next day.
